Intestinal Domination Dynamics:
Among the 317 stool samples, Enterococcus domination was presented in 89 (28%).
Among the 46 patients, Enterococcus domination was observed in 30 (65.2%).
Stool cultured was performed from samples with Enterococcus domination and 30 enterococci were isolated: 11 strains of Enterococcus faecalis and 19 strains of Enterococcus faecium.
Among 1059 samples collected prior to allo-HSCT (between D-30 and D-6), 60 (5.7%) had Enterococcus faecium domination.

Enterococcus domination occurred in up to 65% of patients after allo-HSCT. Enterococcus faecium was the dominant species in most patients across all centers.
Enterococcus genus was the most commonly observed to dominate the microbiota in patients from 4 different centers.
